name: Microsoft SQL Server
description: Backup of SQL Server databases, configuration, and system files
recommended_schedule: Hourly Transaction Log, Daily Differential, Weekly Full
notes: Use mssqlvdi plugin for online database backups
Adjust drive letters (D:, E:, F:) to match SQL Server paths
Transaction log backups recommended hourly for point-in-time recovery
Verify SQL Server VSS Writer is enabled and healthy
Consider SQL Server native backups in addition to file-level backups
Backup master, model, msdb system databases
Document SQL Server version, edition, and collation
For Always On Availability Groups, backup from secondary replica

pre_backup_script.description: Optional: Trigger SQL Server backup before file backup
